summary: Full backend + frontend validation of Iteration 157 UI Customization (Option Y). Backend: 4/4 pytest tests passing in test_iteration157_branding.py (public endpoint exposes branding subset, admin PUT persists, non-admin write returns 401/403, partial update preserves untouched fields). Frontend: end-to-end Playwright run logged in as admin, opened branding-editor-card → branding-editor-dialog, changed app_name to 'Acme Field Ops', primary_color to #22c55e, hid /tasks, relabeled /dashboard to 'Home Base', saved. Verified document.title updated to 'Acme Field Ops', --primary CSS variable became HSL triplet '142 71% 45%' (correct conversion from #22c55e), Sign In button background rendered rgb(33,196,93) ≈ #22C55E, sidebar-logo alt switched to 'Acme Field Ops', nav-tasks removed from sidebar, nav-dashboard now shows 'Home Base', login-app-name on /login renders 'Acme Field Ops'. Cleanup PUT successfully reset branding to defaults (verified via /public endpoint).
critical_code_review_comments: BrandingEditor: the `branding-row--tasks` row uses 2 buttons for hide/reorder — recommend adding explicit data-testid like `branding-row-/tasks-hide` to remove the positional guess in tests.

BrandingContext: HSL conversion from hex to CSS --primary is correct (#22c55e → '142 71% 45%' matches expectation). Consider also setting --primary-foreground for contrast on the brand button, otherwise a very dark/light brand color may produce unreadable text.

system_settings.py PUT: silently ignores top-level keys outside the allowed set (email/sentry/org/branding) — fine for security, but consider returning a warning when caller sent unknown top-level keys to aid debugging.

Public endpoint includes branding without rate-limiting — recommend adding caching headers (Cache-Control: public, max-age=30) on /api/admin/system-settings/public since it is called on every page load by all anonymous visitors.

Section override for Finance hide was tested via API in pytest but not exercised in the UI run since the dialog row UI exposes section label edit only via `branding-section-{name}-label` — adding a dedicated `branding-section-{name}-hide` testid would make the section-hide flow directly UI-testable.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test modified branding mid-run and restored defaults via PUT /api/admin/system-settings — confirmed via /public GET that branding is back to {app_name:'58:12 Connect', tagline:'', logo_url:'', primary_color:'', nav_overrides:{}, section_overrides:{}}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 157 (UI customization / branding) is fully wired end-to-end. Backend PUT/GET /api/admin/system-settings + /public work; BrandingContext propagates app_name to document.title, primary_color to --primary CSS var (hex→HSL), logo_url to sidebar-logo + login-logo, app_name to login-app-name + sidebar-logo alt. nav_overrides (hide/relabel/order) and section_overrides apply in Layout.jsx sidebar. The logo_url image swap was not explicitly verified with a real image URL in the Playwright run (sidebar-logo alt change was verified instead) — main agent should consider adding an automated screenshot check if pixel-perfect logo swap matters. Branding is restored to defaults so live app is unchanged.
